request.style: English, Coptic Orthodox hymn, a male cantor singing long melismatic phrases answered by a group of deacons, hand cymbals and a triangle keeping time, ancient Egyptian church modes, solemn and ornate, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the year that King Uzziah died
I saw the Lord on a high and lofty throne
The train of his robe filled the temple
Seraphim stood above him

[Chorus]
Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of hosts
The whole earth is full of his glory

[Verse]
With two wings they covered their faces
With two wings they covered their feet
With two wings they flew
And they called out to one another

[Chorus]
Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of hosts
The whole earth is full of his glory

[Outro]
Holy, holy, holy
